lead_questions: Amendment semantics: does the published contract allow amending a registered capture, and with which route and headers?
Local-run auth mode: which credential form does the local backend expect from the published client? The client can send a bearer token on API routes only; no CLI flag supplies one yet.
Clock and expiry authority: whose clock governs capture expiry on the local backend?
Homeowner text: confirm that receipts may carry outcome kinds and counts but never messages, prompts or reasons.
